name: Vishal Singh
body:
I had an absolutely wonderful stay at Mystic Dreamville with my friend and both our families. From the moment we arrived, everything exceeded our expectations. The property is beautifully maintained, very clean, and has a peaceful, relaxing vibe that makes it perfect for a family getaway.

The home-cooked food was truly delicious—fresh, flavorful, and made with so much care. It felt just like eating at home, which made the experience even more special. The pool area was spotless and well-kept, and both kids and adults had a great time enjoying it.

One of the best parts was the convenience—the location is easily accessible and close to the nearby bus stand and restaurants, which made getting around very easy. The rooms were spacious, comfortable, and thoughtfully arranged, ensuring everyone had a pleasant stay.

The hospitality was exceptional. The hosts were warm, attentive, and always ready to help, making us feel welcomed throughout our stay. The overall ambiance, cleanliness, food quality, and service truly make Mystic Dreamville a perfect destination for families and groups.

Highly recommended! Looking forward to visiting again soon.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

name: 39_Sneha Patil
body: Had an amazing stay at the villa! The place was beautiful, clean, and very well maintained. The rooms were comfortable, and the ambiance was peaceful and relaxing. I Highly recommend this villa and would love to visit again!

name: sonali raj
body: Great experience staying at this villa in Lonavala with my friends. The rooms were clean and comfortable, the service was excellent, and the overall atmosphere was very pleasant. A perfect place to relax and spend quality time with friends. Highly recommended!

name: Biren Mutneja
body: Mystic Dreamville in Lonavala is a serene, cost-friendly gem! The pristine swimming pool is crystal clear—perfect for relaxing dips. Super peaceful with not much noise, ideal for unwinding. The owner is very understanding and accommodating, helping with local tips without being intrusive. Spacious, clean, and comfy. Definitely worth the price for the quality it offers. Highly recommend for a rejuvenating escape!

name: Anish varma
body: Everything was good, Host was helpful. Caretaker was attentive, Villa location is good and accessible everywhere, kitchen utensils are completely available. Highly recommended for friends, family for peaceful outing and stay

name: Sanjay Jayakumar
body: Booked this place for a Bachelor party. It was wonderful. The villa was near and tidy, the pool was clean. The kitchen was sufficient. Extra beds were provided which was nice. The place had wifi and a bluetooth speaker which was nice. The location has all options for food delivery. The one very tiny thing is that it isn't located at a scenic location which I personally did not mind honestly. Had conversations with both partners and they were very supportive to talk to. Special shoutout to the local food supplying person recommended by the owner. The food was delectable. Overall, we had a wonderful time. Go ahead and book the villa without a second thought.

name: Anoop Yesodhar
body: Excellent Home Stay, . Got warm welcome. Kitchen was stocked with fresh milk, water bottles, tea, coffee sugar, and ice . Whole villa is very well maintained. Swimming pool was clean. Good set of toiletries. Caretaker was very good person like his helpful mind thank u dada, Thanks Mr Michael, we enjoyed our 1  days of stay. Highly Recommended....

name: Vaibhav Telang
body: Excellent host, gave all required information before coming. Got warm welcome. Kitchen was stocked with fresh milk, water bottles, tea, coffee sugar, ice and best was ginger 😊. Whole villa is very well maintained. Swimming pool was clean. Good set of toiletries. Pillows and blankets were little damp but you call and you can get them replaced. Thanks Michael, we enjoyed our 2 days of stay.

name: Simran Hingle
body:
Just wrapped up the most refreshing getaway at a beautiful 3BHK villa in Lonavala — and it was everything a staycation should be! ✨

The villa was spotless, well-maintained, and thoughtfully done up, with spacious rooms and great attention to detail. The terrace seating was perfect for lazy evening chats under the stars, while the poolside setup made for the most relaxing afternoons. 💦☀️

The pool was a total highlight — clean, well-sized, and with a view that made every dip feel like a little slice of paradise.

Service was absolutely top-notch — warm, prompt, and so accommodating. Whether it was food, cleaning, or just general help, everything was handled seamlessly.

Would 100% recommend for anyone looking to unwind with family or friends. Already dreaming of going back! 🏡🌄

name: Abhishek Bhone
body: We recently stayed at this beautiful villa and our experience was absolutely wonderful. The place was impeccably clean and neat, with special attention given to the swimming pool, which was freshly cleaned before our arrival. The owner is incredibly welcoming, kind and genuine person.The caretaker and housemaid greeted us with a refreshing welcome drink and we were introduced about every facility which set the tone for a perfect stay. Everything about this villa was exactly as described -genuine and true to the photos and reviews. Highly recommend it for a relaxing and enjoyable getaway! If you reading this trust me you gonna have a great time.

name: sameer shaikh
body:
We had the pleasure of staying at Mystic Dream Villa twice in one month, and both visits were absolutely unforgettable. The villa is beautifully maintained, with a serene atmosphere that made it the perfect escape from our busy lives.
Every detail—from the tasteful decor to the peaceful surroundings—created a truly relaxing experience. The staff was exceptionally welcoming and made us feel right at home. It’s rare to find a place that’s both luxurious and family-friendly, but Mystic Dream Villa hits the mark perfectly.
My family especially loved the spacious layout, the stunning views, and the overall peaceful vibe. It’s clear that a lot of thought and care has gone into creating this special retreat.
We’re already looking forward to our next visit. Highly recommend Mystic Dream Villa to anyone seeking a dreamy, relaxing escape!

name: Tejas Kasat
body: We stayed there for 2 days. Manish, the owner of the property, is an excellent host. He was proactive and called a few days before the check in to share a few things about the property and a few restaurant options. There was a caretaker available along with a maid. Kitchen was completely stacked. Location is also very good and it is near the city Center. The property is value for money.

name: simran singh
body:
I & my frnds had gone visited the mystic Dreamville very recently.
We had an amazing stay at this beautiful and cozy place ! From the moment we arrived, it was clear that cleanliness and hygiene are a top priority here. The villa was spotless, with every corner impeccably maintained. The decor was lovely, and the space was both cozy and modern. The attention to detail in ensuring everything was perfectly sanitized was greatly appreciated. It truly felt like a home away from home, and we couldn't have asked for a better experience. If you're looking for a relaxing, clean, and well-kept place to stay, this villa is a must-go! Highly recommend it!"
